name: Money & Travel Documents
seo: Money and paperwork for visitors and long-stayers: ATMs that accept foreign cards, money changers with rates worth crossing the street for, bank branches, remittance counters like Palawan and Cebuana, and where to handle visa extensions with the Bureau of Immigration. Fees and locations on every card, because the wrong ATM costs PHP 250 a withdrawal.

subSeo.ATMs: ATMs that accept foreign cards, with withdrawal limits and the fee to expect.
subSeo.Money Changers: Exchange counters with competitive rates for USD, EUR, KRW and JPY.
subSeo.Banks: Bank branches for accounts, transfers and cash — BDO, BPI, Metrobank and the rest.
subSeo.Remittance: Palawan, Cebuana Lhuillier, Western Union and pawnshop counters for sending and receiving money.
subSeo.Visa Services: Visa extensions, 13A applications and immigration paperwork. Being added — list your consultancy here.
